name: Sawatari Miyako
source: She is an art teacher. She is especially popular among male students and male colleagues because of her good looks and ample body. She is an earnest and hardworking person who has been improving herself in order to live up to the respect and expectations of those around her. In spite of her flamboyant appearance and popularity, she has never had any experience with men.
